player_prompt.intro:
Kamohelo ho Frozen Lake!

U emelwa ke 'P' ho grid.
Mabone a grid:
  ' ' = Sehlahla se tlotsitsoeng (se bolokehile ho tsamaya ho sona)
  'H' = Lesaka (o itlama, o lahlehelwa ke mofuthu!)
  'G' = Sepheo (fihla ho sona o wene!)
  'P' = Sebaka sa hao sa jwale

Metswako e teng: hodimo, tlas'e, lehlakoreng la ho lewa, lehlakoreng la ho ja (kapa w, a, s, d)
Ngola metswako ya hao jwalo ka: [up], [down], [left], [right] kapa [w], [a], [s], [d]

Sepheo: Tsamaya ho tloha qalong (hodimo-holimo lehlakoreng la ho lewa) ho isa sepheong (tlas'e-holimo lehlakoreng la ho ja) ntle le ho itlama lesakeng!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsamayo e hloileha ha tsamaiso. Sebelisa [up], [down], [left], [right] kapa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Ketso e sa tsejoeng '{action}'. Sebelisa holimo, tlase, ka ho le letšehali, ka letsohong le letona kapa w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: U ile ua leka ho tsamaea {action} empa u thula lerako!

game_action.moved: O ile oa tsamaya {action} ho ya kaebe ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Kea le leboha! Le fihlile moo le batlang ho ea teng.
outcome.fell_in_hole: U oele ka sekoting! Papali e felile. O phethile {pct}% ea leeto ho leba ntlheng eo u batlang ho fihla ho eona.
outcome.turn_limit: U fihlile moeling oa ho potoloha! Papali e felile. O phethile {pct}% ea leeto la hao le lebisang pakane.
